ana: quick check — are we set to flip the v2 header for slice-4 tonight? RFC had 11:00pm PT as the target.
leo: working on the SDK release now, one PR is blocked by the eng-infra proxy change (CL#4321). ETA ~2h.
sam: docs are updated, but runtime changelog still needs an entry. @ashley can you add the runtime note + rollback steps?
ashley: on it. btw CI is flaky on auth parsing: seeing a failure in integration that looks like header mapping missing. log excerpt:
```
Error: auth header not recognized: "x-rw-compat"
stack: AuthParser.parse -> ProxyHandler.handle
```
qa-bot: integration-ci build #552 — auth-headers.test failed (flake?). Re-run queued.
leo: the proxy CL introduces a header mapping x-rw-v2 -> Authorization token. If runtime flag isnt enabled, requests from new SDK variant will hit 403.

leo: I'd prefer not to ship shims long-term, but small shim for canary is fine to keep traffic steady. I'll land the PR and tag a canary build 1.4.3-canary.
